data.name: Revelation Strike
data.description: After hitting with an unarmed strike, you can spend 2 stamina points to apply the effects of your chosen revelationAPG as a free action instead of a swift action. If the chosen revelation has unlimited daily uses, this combat trick costs 5 stamina points instead.
